description:
Upload an image, video (mp4/webm), audio (mp3/wav/m4a/aac) or a document for a presentation or document job, up to 10 MiB, as base64.

Returns key and url; either can be used as a media reference (for example Higgsfield
image_urls, video_urls, audio_urls). The file type is checked by content, not by the header.

A document (PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, MD, CSV) is for the file_urls of create_presentation, revise_presentation,
create_document and revise_document: pass the returned url there within a day. The answer also has filename, the name the
presentation agent sees: Cyrillic is dropped from it, so name the file in Latin letters when the name matters.
name: upload_media
